title: Continuum Hypothesis
exact_target: The continuum hypothesis says that every uncountable subset of the real numbers has the same cardinality as the real numbers. Its truth cannot be decided from ZFC alone, assuming ZFC is consistent.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 22 (SET-001). CC BY 4.0.
